answer: The pigment counter is kept in delta and nectar exposes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Each duplicate costs another 107 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
